observations.why: Directive enacts authority-ranking: speaker sets a recurring obligation by fiat, allocating organizational time without negotiation.

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Speaker reframes unrehearsed rollback as nonexistent, leveraging authority to define what counts as real capability — a definitional fiat that forecloses argument.
Declarative cadence-setting enacts authority-ranking: the owner publishes a schedule the organization is expected to follow.
Self-designation as owner enacts authority-ranking: the speaker claims unilateral custodial authority over the rehearsal program.
